name: Fontpair
summary: Font pairing tool: browse and preview 1,000+ curated Google Font combinations with your own content.
description: Fontpair is a web tool for picking typography: browse 1,000+ curated pairings built on free Google Fonts, preview a pairing with your own content and save favorites. The site also has sections for fonts and alternatives, colors, inspiration and icon libraries, plus a Figma plugin, an extension and integrations for Canva, Adobe, WordPress, Squarespace, Webflow, Framer and Shopify.
